'''Cords''' is a sergeant in [[Gareth Bryne]]'s army.

== Appearance ==
He is a heavyset man. His chin is bristling with red hair.

== Activities ==
When [[Gawyn Trakand]] first enters Bryne's camp he asks to see Bryne himself. Cords tells him to go see Captain [[Aldan]] who is in charge of recruits. Gawyn refuses and engages Cords and a number of his men in a sword fight and defeats them all. Bryne arrives on the scene and rebukes Cords for not sending Gawyn straight to him.{{ref/book|12|24}}
